messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx and p95 on /v1/chat.generate in us-east-1 (since ~2026-03-15T10:12Z). error-rate ~2.8x, streaming connections spiking. paging @devon @maria @kenji.

devon: on it. quick sanity: no runtime deploys in last 3h, model pool healthy but some backends show slow GC spikes. suspect client-side stream saturation + routing burst. will propose per-route mitigation first.

maria: agree keep embeddings/rerank untouched unless we see cross-route impact. customers with heavy embedding usage should not be throttled.

devon: mitigation plan (immediate):
1) apply per-route soft quota on /v1/chat.generate at edge for hosted traffic
2) tighten concurrent stream limit per key (3 -> 2) for public tiers
3) enable automatic fallback to lite/chat-small for requests flagged as bursty
I'll apply step 1 and 2 now.

kenji: make the quota change scoped by route and by tier. use the admin API: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/api/quotas/modify \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"scope":"hosted","route":"/v1/chat.generate","per_minute":2400,"burst":600,"policy":"soft"}'
```
This sets a soft backpressure; will start returning 429s for excessive clients but preserve enterprise reservations.

logan: pushed per-key RPS caps as emergency hotfix: free=8 RPS, trial=25 RPS, standard=60 RPS. rerank: added a safety cap only for anonymous keys -> hard 30 RPS. embeddings: left alone but added per-key abuse detector (token rate > 100k/min triggers review).

devon: applied edge rule and updated traffic-shaper: concurrent_streams_per_key=2 for public. logs: 
```
Edge: set route=/v1/chat.generate per_min=2400 burst=600 policy=soft by=devon
Shaper: concurrent_limit=2 per_api_key scope=public
```

sre-bot: metrics update: in-flight chat streams down from ~2800 -> ~1100 in 7m. 5xx ratio dropped 60%. p95 latency from 2.4s -> 1.2s. continuing to track onboard dashboard. :eyes:

maria: customer impact summary: flagged customers with errors (trial/heavy): flux-labs, clearview-dev, partner-staging. created CS tickets: #TICK-482, #TICK-483, #TICK-484; marked P2. notified their SEs. no enterprise accounts in breach of SLA so far.

kenji: handoff plan 1: I'll take next 30m. Handoff checklist for oncall:
- confirm in-flight < 1k
- 5xx < 0.5%
- streaming connections stable and not slowly creeping back up
- check fallback rates to lite model (measure quality fallout)
If metrics look good for 30m, we can incrementally relax soft limit by +25% and restore concurrent_stream limit to 3.

devon: note: toggled feature-flag to disable unbounded streaming for trial keys only: fflags.set("disable_unbounded_streaming_trial", true)
This reduced long-lived connections originating from automated test rigs. watch token churn.

logan: also added temporary route-based quota exception for enterprise-tier keys: exclude enterprise API keys from the new per-route soft limit so customer SLAs remain intact. command used: 
```
POST /admin/quotas/modify {"scope":"hosted","route":"/v1/chat.generate","exceptions":["tier:enterprise"]}
```

maria: support notes: CS drafted canned message for affected customers explaining temporary throttling, mitigation steps, and ETA for normalization (~45m). linking ticket ids in thread.

sre-bot: 15m update: error-rate trending down. in-flight streams ~980. p95=1.05s. 429s increased by 0.7% (expected). continuing to watch for any cross-impact on embeddings or rerank.

kenji: taking the lead. leaving the playbook here: if errors re-increase after relaxing: rollback gateway rule, re-enable streaming for trials if necessary (but prefer model fallback), or full route circuit-break to preserve backend stability. escalate to oncall-sre if persistent >15m.

devon: thanks team. I'll stay available for rollback. logging retrospective notes and will follow up with a post-incident summary including per-endpoint quota recommendations (defaults we might adopt: chat public 3k/min soft, trial cap 25 RPS, free cap 8 RPS; embeddings default 10k/min soft; rerank hard 30 RPS anon).

kenji: closing handoff. will reopen if any regression. :white_check_mark:
